body: Qualifying isn't the same as registering. A fencer who earns a Junior Olympics spot, including through a division qualifier, still has to sign up; USA Fencing says it does not register anyone automatically. The regular-fee deadline is Nov. 11, even if a fencer's qualifier comes later; the entry stays "pending" until qualification is confirmed. Division results can take two to five days to reach USA Fencing. The 2027 Junior Olympics run Jan. 8–11 in Oklahoma City.

After October's NAC, the first with fields split into Elite and Challenger, r/Fencing compared notes. The top-voted take came from a fan of the change: top fencers used to coast through easy pools and early DEs, and now they meet strong opponents every round. One fencer placed in Elite called it the most concentrated U.S. event they'd seen. Another put it simply: "Pools was tough but it was a lot more fun." Not everyone was sold. One poster said coaches called the day brutal for coaches and referees, and another argued the tiers reflect how often you compete more than how well you fence. Others said one event is too early to judge, and several want the 20% pool cut dropped in Challenger.
